title: Muon MATRIX_LR sweep (0.04 -> 0.05)
description: Increased MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05 (25% higher Muon LR), all else unchanged from DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.005816, worse than baseline 1.002279. A 25% Muon LR increase regresses training at this budget, suggesting the baseline LR=0.04 was already near-optimal (or the true optimum is below 0.04, not above). Future LR sweeps should probe downward (e.g. 0.03) rather than upward.
